title: Audio-only impression is filled with a VAST document whose MediaFile is video/mp4

specNotes: crosscheck.js has zero references to `audio` anywhere in the file (confirmed by grep) — imp.audio receives no size, format or VAST-shape equivalent of the video block's isVastShape gate, so a VAST document whose only MediaFile declares video/mp4 for an audio-only impression produces no crosscheck finding at all.

This is not caught at the schema-validation layer either: packages/core/rules-vast.js's R15 MediaFile-type check (VALID_MF_TYPES) is an allowlist of ten VIDEO container MIME types and contains no audio MIME type at all — video/mp4 passes the check as 'valid' regardless of the fact that the impression requested audio/mpeg, and no rule reads imp.audio.mimes to compare against the returned MediaFile.type.

Same underlying architectural gap as mut-format-mismatch-banner-vast-adm: neither the banner slot nor the audio slot has any check that the returned creative's content type actually matches the offered media object; only imp.video has an equivalent (isVastShape) check at all.
notes: Browser acceptance 2026-09-08 independently reproduced the existing semantic/preview deviation through the actual Analyze action. Only the reviewed failure strings are admitted on the browser layer; all declared assertions remain unchanged.
